highlights: AI agent capabilities are significantly advancing, with new frameworks enabling more robust, memory-aware, and specialized autonomous systems for complex tasks.
Major strides are being made in enterprise AI safety and efficient model deployment, driven by new tools optimizing performance and privacy features from leading providers.

The democratization of AI continues, with open-source model releases, free access to advanced coding tools, and comprehensive educational initiatives empowering a broader range of developers and users.

agents.title: Harvey Introduces Harvey Tenet: Long-Horizon Legal Agent Work
agents.summary: Harvey Tenet, a Kimi K3 base model post-trained with Fireworks, significantly enhances long-horizon legal agent task completion, enabling specialized, high-performance AI for complex legal workflows.

agents.title: SDAD: Spec-Driven Agentic Development for the AI-Native SDLC
agents.summary: This paper formalizes Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD), a paradigm leveraging frontier coding agents to boost software development velocity and precision by prioritizing specification quality and multi-agent verification.

agents.title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure
agents.summary: PrimeAgentOrchestrator (PAO) is a system that spawns new coding agents pre-loaded with relevant context and memories from personal databases, improving agent efficiency and knowledge retention across sessions by bridging heterogeneous memory systems.

models.title: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security
models.summary: Anthropic has integrated its cyber-capable Claude Mythos 5 model into Claude Security, providing enterprise teams with frontier vulnerability scanning capabilities and suggested patches, without requiring direct model access, for enhanced software supply chain security.

models.title: Meta Introduces Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, and Open Source
models.summary: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, an open-source model that is local, agentic, and multimodal, providing developers with a powerful and flexible foundation for building advanced AI applications with full deployment control.

models.title: Truth Lies Deep: Countering Semantic Camouflage via Latent Intent Verification
models.summary: This research introduces Latent Intent Verification (LIV), a lightweight defense that detects harmful intent in LLMs by analyzing early-layer activations, outperforming standard guardrails against semantic camouflage attacks without model retraining.

tools.title: Meet FreeToken: Edge-Native MoE Serving Engine for 753B GLM-5.2 on Single GPU
tools.summary: FreeToken is an edge-native MoE serving engine that enables running massive 753B GLM-5.2 models on a single workstation GPU by optimizing cache misses, significantly democratizing access to frontier models for local execution.

tools.title: Nexus: Optimizing Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory with KV-Cache Splicing and Decoupled Tool Routing
tools.summary: Nexus optimizes agentic LLM performance on unified memory by decoupling tool routing from schema prefill costs using an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer, delivering up to 1.7x speedup in time-to-first-token and significant token savings.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and Expanded Capabilities
tools.summary: Google's Gemini API Managed Agents receive new capabilities, including 3.6 Flash, hooks, background tasks, and remote MCP support, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents efficiently.

companies.title: OpenAI Offers Zero Data Retention for Frontier Models
companies.summary: OpenAI reaffirms its Zero Data Retention policy for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing, enabling advanced AI safety measures without compromising user data privacy, crucial for enterprise adoption.

companies.title: Replit Expands Software Creation Access with GPT-5.6 Luna Free Mode
companies.summary: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, democratizing software creation by allowing anyone to turn ideas into working applications without worrying about token costs, significantly lowering the barrier to entry for developers.

companies.title: Asana Cleared 5 Years of Engineering Work in 2 Weeks with Codex
companies.summary: Asana leveraged OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in just two weeks, accomplishing work that was projected to take five years for approximately $12K, demonstrating massive productivity gains and cost efficiency in software development.

learning.title: The Developer’s Guide to NeMo Guardrails for Enterprise AI Safety
learning.summary: This tutorial provides a comprehensive guide to designing production-grade safety for LLM-based applications using NeMo Guardrails, covering advanced techniques like PII redaction, retrieval filtering, and policy-based tool gating for secure and compliant AI assistants.

learning.title: The Builder’s Guide to GPT‑5.6
learning.summary: OpenAI has released a new builder's guide for GPT-5.6, offering practical insights and new API capabilities to help startups and developers build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection.

learning.title: Building an End-to-End Document Intelligence Pipeline with deepDoctection
learning.summary: This tutorial guides developers through creating a robust document intelligence pipeline using deepDoctection, covering configuring layout analysis, OCR, table extraction, custom entity recognition, and structured JSONL data generation for RAG workflows.
